test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

It seemed that his route / to the covted island / was not to be / an easy one.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"covted"** is incorrect. It should be **"coveted"**. • **Meaning:** **Coveted** means to desire something strongly. (लालायित) • **Example:** The athlete coveted the championship trophy. • **"Coveted"** means something that is greatly desired or envied. (लालायित) • **Example:** The **coveted **prize was finally within his reach. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **an easy one** (एक आसान): Something that is not difficult. (आसान) • **Example:** This task is an easy one for him. • **It seemed that his route** (ऐसा प्रतीत हुआ कि उसका मार्ग): Indicates a perception or belief about someone's path. (ऐसा प्रतीत हुआ कि उसका मार्ग) • **Example:** It seemed that his route was filled with challenges. • **was not to be** (नहीं होना था): Indicates something that was not destined to happen. (नहीं होना था) • **Example:** His success was not to be, despite his efforts. 174:Tb71, The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
